open_points.subject: A05 proof edge/node ordering with flow endpoints
open_points.text: "edges, by (`to_node`, `to_port`, `from_node`, `from_port`)" and "from_node/from_port: a node's output port or a flow input; to_node/to_port: a node's input port or a flow output"
open_points.question: How are `from_node`/`to_node` represented and ordered when an endpoint is a flow input/output (not a node), so the "first failing edge" is deterministic?
options: Use reserved synthetic node ids for flow endpoints (for example `$flow_input`, `$flow_output`)
Use nullable node fields and define null ordering explicitly
Store separate endpoint kind fields and define tuple ordering across kinds
open_points.default_guess: Use reserved synthetic endpoint ids and include them in the Unicode code-point sort.

open_points.subject: A05 schema equality in proof
open_points.question: Does "same schema" mean byte-identical/canonical-JSON-equal schema documents, or semantic equivalence under the supported schema subset?
open_points.default_guess: Treat schemas as equal only by canonical JSON equality.

open_points.subject: A11 attempt numbering vs pre-send failure
open_points.text: "An attempt is ... one send of an operation element" and "An attempt whose pre-send check failed has that NodeExecution (`operation_failed`) and no EffectAttempt"
open_points.question: If pre-send checks fail before any request is sent, does that still consume an `attempt_number` and produce a numbered NodeExecution attempt?
options: Yes, pre-send failure is still a numbered attempt
No, only actual sends are attempts; pre-send failure is unnumbered/non-attempt
open_points.default_guess: Yes, consume an attempt number (as the later rule text implies).

open_points.subject: A13 empty-map conclusion vs trace completeness
open_points.text: "A mapped node over an empty list ... writes no NodeExecution and concludes succeeded"
open_points.question: Where is this node-level success persisted/read from if no NodeExecution is written, given run-end logic depends on node conclusions?
options: Persist separate per-node run-state outside NodeExecution
Emit a synthetic NodeExecution status for empty-map success
Recompute node conclusion from inputs/graph each time
open_points.default_guess: Keep separate per-node runtime state and do not emit NodeExecution for empty-map success.

open_points.subject: A07 execution class for failure_detail from service error bodies
open_points.text: "The class of an execution is the highest class among the values and files its NodeExecution or TrialExecution names" and "The body of an error response is not interpreted; at most `failure_detail_bytes_max` of it is kept as `failure_detail`"
open_points.question: How is disclosure class assigned to `failure_detail` text sourced from service error bodies when that text is not among named values/files?
options: Treat failure_detail as inheriting execution class computed from named values/files
Never return operation failure_detail text to agents regardless of class
open_points.default_guess: Use execution class from named values/files (current literal reading), even though this may be conservative/incomplete.

open_points.subject: A10/A11 draft-write resend after `not_applied`
open_points.text: "`draft-write` nodes ask nothing at run time" and "resend after `not_applied` ... needs a fresh approval for every effect class, `draft-write` included"
open_points.question: After a `draft-write` attempt is resolved `not_applied`, must the element now create/wait for an EffectApproval (`owner_approval`) before resend?
options: Yes, create approval and wait like other approved effects for this resend
open_points.default_guess: Yes, require and wait for a fresh owner approval before resend.

open_points.subject: A18 symbolic-link refusal scope
open_points.text: "refuses any path inside [the data directory] that is a symbolic link"
open_points.question: Is symlink checking only at startup, or on every runtime file access (spool/value/fixture/temp), and what happens if a symlink appears after startup?
options: Check on every file operation and fail that operation/process
Periodic rescans with fail-fast on detection
open_points.default_guess: Check at each file access and refuse the operation (or stop) when encountered.
